Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a traffic signal in Baytown, Texas, when the rear of the vehicle was struck by Driver 2, whose
vehicle was travelling behind it at a low speed. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and
stated that Passenger was also in the vehicle at the time of impact. Officers confirmed through their own observations
and statements at the scene that Driver 1 and Passenger were present in the vehicle. Scene photographs show
visible rear-end damage to both vehicles, although they do not show every panel or component that was reported as
affected. No independent witnesses were identified, so the account relies on the statements of those involved. Driver
1 is named on the insurance policy covering the struck vehicle. Officers found no information indicating earlier
damage to that vehicle. Whether all of the damage seen on the vehicle resulted from this impact could not be
determined at the scene and may require further inspection.
</page>
